prompt: launch video for a note-taking app

plan.title: A Note-Taking App That Finds Your Ideas Again
plan.description: A one-minute launch video for a note-taking app built around one problem: great ideas get lost in scattered notes. See how capture, organize and search work together so you can find any thought in seconds.

beats.narration: You wrote it down. Somewhere. A great idea, a name, a number you needed today. Now it is buried in a notebook, a phone, three apps and a sticky note. Sound familiar?

clip_queries: hands typing on phone and laptop

beats.narration: Notes should not be a place where ideas go to disappear. They should work for you. So we built a note-taking app around one promise: write it once, find it when you need it.

props.text: Write it once. Find it in seconds.

beats.narration: It works in simple steps. First, capture a thought the moment it arrives. Second, organize it. Third, search, and your note appears.
What changes for you is simple. Less hunting, more doing. The idea you had on the train is there when you need it.
Meet the note-taking app that keeps up with your thinking. Download it today, write your first note, and let your ideas finally stay where you put them.

props.alt: woman typing on laptop in a bright cafe
